sentences.text: This is an application filed under section 389 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1873 seeking suspension of sentence of the appellant no. 1/applicant during the pendency of the appeal.

2. In the present case, the applicant has been convicted for offences under sections 498A/306/34 of IPC, 1860 vide judgment of conviction dated 15.02.2023 and was sentenced for a maximum period of 6 years vide order of sentence dated 28.04.2023.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has produced the custody certificate of the applicant, wherein the period of incarceration undergone by the applicant as on 07.01.2025 is 2 years 6 months and 1 day, has a remission of 6 months and 3 days, leaving an unexpired portion of 3 years 4 days.

4. sentences.text:
5. In Saudan Singh (supra) the Hon'ble Supreme Court inter alia held as under:
"7.

We may note that there may be even convicts in custody in cases other than life sentence cases and in those cases again the broad parameter of 50 per cent of the actual sentence undergone can be the basis for grant of bail."
6. Further, there is no other criminal case pending against the applicant.
The parents of the appellant are senior citizens and are dependent on the appellant for their day to day needs.
7. The appeal in the present case is of the year 2023 and there is no likelihood of the appeal being heard in the near future.

If the sentence of the appellant is not suspended, it could very well be that he would have undergone the entire sentence without his appeal having been heard, leaving the remedy of filing the appeal a mere paper formality.

8. In this view of the matter, I am of the view that the sentence of the appellant needs to be suspended subject to the following terms and conditions:-
i.

The applicant shall furnish a personal bond with one local surety in the sum of Rs.
10,000/- each, to the satisfaction of the Jail This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 05/02/2025 at 22:11:43 Superintendent;

ii. The applicant shall provide his mobile number to the Investigating Officer (IO)
concerned, which shall be kept in working condition at all times.

The applicant shall appear before the Court as and when the appeal is taken up for hearing;
v.
The applicant shall not leave the country without permission from the competent Court and if the appellant has a passport, he shall surrender the same to the Jail Superintendent; vi.
The applicant shall not indulge in any act or omission that is unlawful or that would prejudice the proceedings in pending cases, if any.
9. The application is allowed and disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
